The Thiruparankundram Karthigai Deepam dispute has triggered a political row in Tamil Nadu.
Last week, the Supreme Court allowed the lighting of the lamp, as a “limited one-time arrangement”, on the deepathoon at the Thirupparankundram Hill in Tamil Nadu’s Madurai district on Karthigai Deepam day.The Tamil Nadu government moved to review the order.
Here is what political leaders have said about the Thiruparankundram controversy.
